messages:
Marta: Quick sync — FieldLabs wants to finalize perf/W sweep + kernel knob tuning next week. I sketched a plan below. TL;DR: 3 runs (baseline, quantized, kernel-tuned) across revA/revB. Need orchestration owner + marketplace copy for joint announcement.

Sam: I can own orchestration. I'll set up bench-runner jobs. Need exact models, batch sizes, and board access. Who's the field contact?

Marta: Field contact: @Diego_Field. Models: Llama-2-7B, Mistral-7B. Quant: int4, nf4. Seq lengths: 512 and 2048. Batch sizes: 1 / 8 / 32. Metrics: perf/W, p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec.

Diego_Field: We can provision 4 boards (2x revA, 2x revB). Telemetry we can capture: PDU power, board temp, per-core freq. We'll also export power samples at 10Hz.

Jules: Add GPU counters (SM util, mem_bw), kernel-level traces (memcpy, kernel_launch). We'll merge into trace format. Proposed telemetry manifest:

```yaml
telemetry_manifest: |
  version: 1
  samples:
    - name: pdu_power
      unit: watts
      freq_hz: 10
    - name: board_temp
      unit: celsius
      freq_hz: 1
    - name: sm_util
      unit: percent
      freq_hz: 5
    - name: memcpy_time
      unit: ms
      tags: [kernel]
  retention_days: 14
```

Sam: For orchestration I'll use bench-runner matrix. Example cmd:

```bash
bench-runner run --model {llama2-7b,mistral-7b} \
  --quant {fp16,int4,nf4} --seq {512,2048} \
  --batch {1,8,32} --boards revA,revB --collect-telemetry telemetry_manifest.yaml
```

Chen: Marketplace and joint announcement: don't publish absolute numbers without legal sign-off. We should draft co-auth messaging and have partner comms approve. @Nate can you own the tile copy?

Nate: Yup, I'll draft a short marketplace tile and a partner co-auth statement. Please share preliminary numbers in a private gist (sensitive) and add a "not for public" tag until PR signs off.

Marta: Action items: Sam (orchestration), Jules (telemetry + ingestion), Diego_Field (lab + power hooks), Nate (marketplace copy), Chen (legal/PR). Target dry run Sep 5, public bench Sep 12. +1s?

Jules: +1. I'll push telemetry schema to github.com/redwood/bench-telemetry/fieldlabs and enable 14d retention.

BenchBot: bench-runner queued: job id 0x8fa3 — will report status updates in this thread.

Sam: I'll create the bench-runner jobs today and tag everyone. Thanks :thumbsup:
